heading: Data source and attribution
body: Destination entry-requirement data comes from the <source>TravelRequirements.info — Entry Requirements Dataset</source> by AXG Sp. z o.o., used under the <license>Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0)</license> licence. Visa Expeditor reformatted the data into its own schema, limited it to supported destinations, and added its own verification labels. The dataset creator does not endorse Visa Expeditor.
